newsitem.title: UK: June gilts up over a point after UK rate rise.
newsitem.headline: June gilts up over a point after UK rate rise.

text.p: UK June gilt futures rose over a point on Tuesday after Chancellor Gordon Brown sanctioned a quarter point rise in UK interest rates to 6.25 percent and outlined reforms to the country's monetary policy framework.

By 1017 GMT, June gilts were at 112-13, up 1-9/32 on the day and versus 111-06 before the rate rise. June short sterling was up 0.05 on the day at 93.40 from 93.33 before the move and the September contract was at 93.17 from 93.10 before.
